thread:
sam.runtime: EOD pingwheel — quick status + ownership check on the Dedicated capacity buildout. TL;DR: procurement confirmed 18x A100 equivalents arriving this week, but two reservations still in limbo and a small power gating issue on rack-14. I need owners for: (1) reservation follow-up, (2) rack power sanity check, (3) PR review for the reservation webhook.
maria.platform: I can take reservation follow-up. Which accounts are impacted?
sam.runtime: Thanks — primarily: core-inference-prod and batch-embeddings. The reservations show as 'pending' in the reservation API. I left notes on the ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CI-742. Can you ping procurement + finance?
maria.platform: Yep, will ping. @kevin.infra can you confirm if reservation API errors map to inventory mismatch or billing hold?
kevin.infra: Checking logs now. Quick note: yesterday we got a partial manifest from vendor — some SKUs were remapped (A100->A10x equivalent). API is throwing 409 on SKU mismatch. I'll post logs.
kevin.infra: ```
ERROR reservation/commit 409 {"requested_sku":"A100_v2", "available_sku":"A10x_q", "reservation_id":"res-1912"}
```
kevin.infra: Likely need a small shim to accept compatible SKUs or a reconciliation step. I'll open a short RFC.
nora.ml: Re: rack-14 power gating — I ran the preflight script this morning and saw a transient UPS switchover on one PDUs. Might be firmware. Tagging @jenna.sre for follow-up.
jenna.sre: I can triage. Can you dump the PDU logs and share the SMU output?
nora.ml: PDU logs attached to ticket CI-754. Short term mitigation: we can shift a few slots to rack-12 if needed for the canary.
sam.runtime: Good. For the reservation webhook PR: PR #4620 — it implements an idempotent retry and a new error mapping for compatible SKUs. Need one reviewer from infra and one from platform. @kevin.infra can you review? Also pinging @maria.platform for API contract check.
kevin.infra: I'll do a pass on #4620 by EOD. Heads-up — I left inline comment about rate limiting on the webhook endpoint (we should backoff at 429).
maria.platform: Will check API contract and add a small test for SKU mapping. If procurement accepts the remap policy we can avoid user-facing failures.
sam.runtime: If both of you can review, I'll merge and trigger the reservation-reconcile job.
deploy-bot: reservation-reconcile job queued by sam.runtime — job id job-89210. Estimated run time 6m.
jenna.sre: For the PDU firmware, vendor has a patch (v1.2.7). I propose we schedule a non-disruptive rolling upgrade during the 02:00-04:00 window tonight. Anyone opposed?
maria.platform: OK for me.
kevin.infra: Fine, but we need a fallback in case a node doesn't come up. Suggest a small playbook: (1) block traffic, (2) revert firmware, (3) power-cycle gracefully.
sam.runtime: Agree. Add playbook to the ticket before firmware push. Also, can someone run a quick capacity slotting check? I want to ensure we don't oversubscribe the early canary.
nora.ml: I ran a quick calc: with current reservations and the new arrival we can support 24 reserved slots with 2x buffer for spikes. Recommended initial canary: 10 slots (50% reserved capacity), ramp to 60% over 48h.
sam.runtime: OK — canary plan sounds good. Action summary:
- maria.platform: follow up with procurement + finance on CI-742 (reservation holds)
- kevin.infra: open RFC for SKU reconciliation shim and review PR #4620
- jenna.sre: triage PDU logs + schedule firmware rollout with playbook
- nora.ml: finalize canary slotting plan and add the ramp timeline to CI-754
- sam.runtime: coordinate merge + trigger reservation-reconcile (once reviews done)
maria.platform: I'll post updates here once procurement responds. ETA 2 business hours.
kevin.infra: RFC created: RFC-834-sku-reconcile. PR review started, left 2 comments. ETA for final review: 3h.
jenna.sre: Will prepare playbook and start the firmware window coordination. Posting playbook snippet here for review:
jenna.sre: ```
- cordon nodes in rack-14
- drain pods with grace 60s
- apply firmware v1.2.7 to PDUs
- monitor SMU and health for 10m
- if any node fails, revert firmware and power-cycle
```
sam.runtime: Looks good. One more ask: can someone sanity-check the reservation API with curl before and after the reconcile job? Example:
sam.runtime: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.internal/reservations?account=core-inference-prod" | jq '.[] | {id,status,sku}'
```
nora.ml: I'll run that once deploy-bot finishes the reconcile job.
deploy-bot: reservation-reconcile job job-89210 completed: 12 reconciled, 2 pending (contact required). Duration 5m12s.
maria.platform: Procurement replied — finance put a temporary hold on two reservations pending validation of cost center mapping. They asked for invoice numbers. I added the invoice links to CI-742.
kevin.infra: After reconcile, the API no longer throws 409 for res-1912; map accepted. I merged #4620 (after addressing rate limit comment).
sam.runtime: Great. Two pending items left: finance hold (maria) and PDU firmware window (jenna). If both clear by tomorrow morning we'll shift to canary. Otherwise we delay by 24h.
maria.platform: Noted. I'll aim to clear finance hold today. :crossed_fingers:
jenna.sre: Firmware slate scheduled 02:15 UTC. I'll post a final go/no-go 30m before window.
sam.runtime: Thanks everyone. If anything changes, drop updates here. I'll close the loop tomorrow AM with a short roll decision note. :rocket:
